name: foxpoint
description: VPS-ready starter for the FoxPoint customer site, cabinet and admin panel

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @foxpoint/api && npm run build --workspace @foxpoint/web
scripts.build:prod: npm run db:generate && npm run build
scripts.test:backups: npm run build --workspace @foxpoint/api && python scripts/test-backup-archive.py && node scripts/test-backup-routes.mjs && node scripts/test-full-backup.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @foxpoint/api && npm run lint --workspace @foxpoint/web
